description: Cost of the egress policy per send (bench/send_bench.c, 64-byte messages on loopback): no policy; policy without per-send authorization (cgroup/connect4 + cgroup/sendmsg4); per-send authorization (BPF LSM socket_sendmsg) on a port inside the policed range (identity allowed) and outside it (the cost every other send on the host pays). Connected TCP, connected UDP, and unconnected UDP (sendto). Budget: per-send authorization plus a per-execution budget that is never spent, so every send is also charged (fexit on tcp_sendmsg/udp_sendmsg) and checked.
